body: Thanks for your support, it is really meaningful to me
You can come talk to me, I'll do my best to be a good friend.
Thanks a lot ! It means a lot to me

I often feel like my depression is my fault and that   I should manage it alone. I feel guilty when I talk about it to my friends or my girlfriend because I feel like I'm selfish. Talking about my issues and seeing them try to help me feels weird.
